name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: ToFu: Exploiting and Fuzzing the LLM-Orchestrator-Tool Trust Boundary
items.authors: Md Nazmul Islam Ananto et al.
items.dek: Automated fuzzing of LLM-orchestrator-tool boundaries found 343 tools across 118 MCP servers fail to enforce documented input semantics.
items.unproven: Focus on MCP servers; behavior of tools behind other orchestration layers or in production agent deployments not addressed.

items.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
items.dek: APEX-Harm benchmark of 180 agent tasks shows task-specific script injection succeeds 81–84% of the time even against frontier models.
items.unproven: Benchmark tasks are synthetic; attacks designed by researchers rather than adversaries in the wild; generalization to agent workflows outside finance and legal domains unclear.

items.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
items.dek: Backdoors with encrypted neural networks can hide arbitrary computations in model weights and resist elicitation attempts even under full access.
items.unproven: Threat model assumes adversary cannot obtain the secret trigger; scalability to production-scale models and defenses against trigger discovery through alternative means remain untested.

items.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
items.dek: QTestBench evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmarks; best models' discrimination lags behind execution.
items.unproven: Transferability to production quantum codebases; correlation between test quality and real deployment faults.

items.title: Telegram Desktop vulnerability allowed any user's file to be stolen
items.dek: Telegram Desktop path traversal allowed file theft; vulnerability now patched.
items.unproven: whether the flaw affected production deployments at scale or only under specific user conditions

items.title: Quantum Query Complexity of Maximum Degree and its Generalizations
items.dek: Tight quantum query complexity bounds for maximum-degree and related graph problems; resolves prior conjecture.
items.unproven: Application to cryptographic or SDLC-relevant quantum algorithms; practical deployment constraints.

items.title: Encoding Matters: A Qubit-Efficient Reformulation for Quantum Resilient Routing
items.authors: Emanuele G. Dalla Torre et al.
items.dek: Structure-aware qubit encoding cuts routing-problem circuit size 100X on trapped-ion hardware—quantum optimization advance, weak actionability for AppSec engineer.
items.unproven: single benchmark problem; does not establish how encoding principles transfer to cryptographic or post-quantum migration problems

items.title: A Systematic Study of Security Enforcement at Android Inter-Component Boundaries
items.dek: Systematic audit of Android inter-component security found 97 enforcement gaps across 30 Google and AOSP packages.
items.unproven: Study covers Android 17 on curated packages; does not establish whether gaps are exploitable in realistic threat models or present in third-party applications.

items.title: EviRepair: Evidence-Driven Agents for Reliable Vulnerability Repair
items.dek: Multi-agent framework for automated vulnerability repair improves resolution rates by 16–40% through evidence verification.
items.unproven: Improvements measured on benchmark sets; no evidence that evidence review reduces false-positive repairs or is necessary in production SDLC tooling.

items.title: Scandinavia's first farmers slaughtered hunter-gatherer population, DNA suggests
items.dek: Genetic evidence shows early Scandinavian farmers displaced hunter-gatherers.
items.unproven: unrelated to application security, secure SDLC, or any engineering discipline the reader owns

items.title: Valen's Memory Safety: A New Kind of Borrow Checking
items.dek: Valen proposes an alternative memory-safety model using borrow checking without traditional lifetime syntax.
items.unproven: language research with no evidence of adoption in production systems or impact on SAST/DAST tooling the reader operates

items.title: An entangling Hubbard quasiparticle collider on a digital quantum processor
items.dek: Quasiparticle scattering in Fermi-Hubbard model realized on IBM quantum processor; transmission probability matches Bethe ansatz.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's domain; quantum physics research with no application to application security, SDLC, or enterprise systems.

items.title: A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
items.dek: Warped Born rule in quantum mechanics drives many-body systems to frozen or hyperuniform configurations via repeated measurement.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's domain; theoretical quantum mechanics with no bearing on security engineering or enterprise systems.

items.title: Maximally antiflat fixed-particle-number fermionic states
items.dek: Characterization of maximally antiflat fermionic states and their four-point correlation structure.
items.unproven: Relevance to any applied domain; measurement feasibility on near-term hardware.

items.title: An Annealing-based Quantum Neural Network with Discrete Wavelet Transforms for Enhanced Air Pollution Nowcasting
items.dek: Hybrid quantum-classical network for PM2.5 forecasting on a 172-qubit neuromorphic platform outperforms LSTM baselines.
items.unproven: Generalization to other datasets, geographies, or pollutants; applicability beyond the single UK urban dataset; comparison to tuned classical baselines.

items.title: Bicycle Race: small two-block codes on the Pareto frontier
items.dek: Systematic census of ~10^8 two-block quantum LDPC codes up to 320 qubits identifies Pareto-optimal constructions.
items.unproven: Decoder performance on these codes; physical error thresholds; scalability beyond enumerated sizes.

items.title: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
items.dek: GPU-parallelized belief-propagation decoder for quantum LDPC achieves 13×–17× latency reduction on bivariate bicycle codes.
items.unproven: Decoder performance on error rates at or above physical threshold; generalization to other code families; real hardware integration.

items.title: No advantage from classical assistance for energy-constrained bosonic dephasing channels
items.dek: Proof that classical assistance provides no capacity gain for energy-constrained bosonic dephasing channels.
items.unproven: Extension to non-dephasing or multi-mode channels; practical relevance to quantum communication systems.

items.title: Decision-Focused Learning for Cyber-Physical Risk-Aware Power Grid Operations
items.dek: Optimization-learning framework jointly minimizes detection error and power grid operational costs in intrusion detection.
items.unproven: Evaluation on two datasets only; no comparison to operational baselines or deployment in live control systems; cost-model generalization unclear.

items.title: Enhanced analogue quantum computation with a logically-encoded XX gadget
items.dek: Truss gadget generates two-body XX interactions on superconducting annealers; 1000× improvement on weighted maximum-independent-set instances.
items.unproven: Scaling to larger or diverse problem instances; comparison across different annealer platforms; advantage over native XX implementations.

items.title: A Hardware-Native Trapped-Ion Hybrid Qudit-Oscillator Instruction Set
items.dek: Hardware-native hybrid qudit-oscillator instruction set for trapped-ion processors proves universality with three operation families.
items.unproven: Compilation overhead and gate-time scaling; error rates on physical qudits; advantage over qubit-only approaches at useful scale.

items.title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
items.dek: Combinatorial fusion of structurally diverse quantum circuits and classical models yields up to 6% accuracy gain on four binary classification tasks.
items.unproven: Scaling to larger datasets and circuits; generalization beyond four benchmarks; computational cost of fusion vs. single-model improvement.

items.title: QTN-RQNN: Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network
items.dek: Quantum tensor network recurrent neural network for fault diagnosis on imbalanced datasets—quantum ML benchmark, not security-relevant.
items.unproven: limited to four fault-diagnosis datasets; does not establish generalization to production QML systems or security properties

items.title: Finite-Size Limits of Adaptive Pauli Prediction
items.dek: Adaptive Pauli predictions on quantum systems require Ω(√n) copies—quantum information theory with no application security relevance.

items.title: Operational signatures of exceptional quantum channels
items.dek: Operational theory of exceptional points in quantum channels through measurement outcomes—quantum dynamics, outside reader's scope.

noise.title: `123456' password used in Danish CPR data breach
noise.dek: Danish breach exposed millions; attackers used trivial password on admin account.

noise.title: Germany transforms former coal mines into Europe's largest lake landscape
noise.dek: Germany converts mines to lakes; environmental infrastructure project unrelated to security.

noise.title: Scam American companies are using to manipulate ingredient lists
noise.dek: Social media thread on ingredient list manipulation; consumer fraud, not software security.
